## Scope

Describe the authorized change and the issue or decision that permits it.

## Verification

- [ ] I am an explicitly authorized collaborator.
- [ ] I have a separate contribution agreement or explicit written permission.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private keys, personal data, school-internal data, production identifiers, or proprietary vendor material.
- [ ] I did not add an open-source license to repository-owned material.
- [ ] Public-readiness and required CI checks pass.
- [ ] Any Syncfusion-dependent licensed verification was run only through the protected `syncfusion-licensed-build` environment.

## Evidence

List commands, tests, and sanitized artifacts. Do not paste secrets, cookies,
tokens, private URLs, real user data, or full connection strings.
